tool_calls.name: edit_handoff
tool_calls.arguments: {"edits":[{"old":"| CP-3C | Context ready; legal-capacity assessment not ready: G01/G02/G06/G07, O01 and X02/X04. | Separates actual willingness, structural claim mix and historical feasibility from contractual permission. | Obtain executed instruments, collateral/guarantor schedules, amendments, baskets and covenant certificate; do not turn compliance into headroom. |","new":"| CP-3C | Ready with limitations for historical refinancing and liability-management risk inputs: G01/G02/G06/G07, X02/X04, TL financing events and F09/F10. | Distinguishes historical funding access, maturity management and secured claim mix from future refinancing feasibility or LME risk conclusions; no LME is established by supplied evidence. | Obtain executed legal terms, current market/refinancing evidence, hedging and cash-fungibility inputs before dependent conclusions. No legal headroom, future market access or freely available cash assurance; keep October events separate. |"},{"old":"| CP-4 | Ready with limitations for evidence-based committee synthesis: CT rows, timeline, contrary evidence, conflicts and missing dimensions. | Prevents promotional aftermarket claims or a high rubric output from becoming unsupported credit certainty. | Preserve management-language tags and time boundary; resolve material factual/legal gaps before a complete decision pack. No instrument or recovery recommendation supplied. |","new":"| CP-4 | Annual-disclosure context ready; legal/covenant interpretation not ready: O01, X02/X04, G07, Q18, CF01 and GAP02. | Frames review of what the legal/covenant package actually permits; reported compliance and historical execution do not establish contractual permission or headroom. | Obtain executed credit agreements, indentures and amendments, collateral/guarantor schedules, covenant certificate, restricted-payment baskets and covenant add-back/pro forma bridge. Test distribution, debt/lien and leakage permissions against those documents; no legal-capacity conclusion from annual disclosure alone. |"},{"old":"| CP-6 | Ready with limitations for monitoring/reporting context: dated TL events, extraction/support distinctions, audit integration and GAP register. | Sets observable triggers for cash leakage, acquisition integration, rollover and disclosure changes. | Request dated follow-up/proxy/quarterly evidence; do not present October settlement or the historical governance score as a current event. |","new":"| CP-6 | Ready with limitations for investment-committee debate and challenge: C/CT strengths and risks, TL history, governance drivers, contrary evidence, conflicts and unresolved GAP register. | Enables challenge of aftermarket durability, extraction risk, acquisition demands and refinancing counterevidence without treating management language or the rubric output as credit certainty. | Preserve source categories, missing dimensions and the historical time boundary; request material legal, ownership, cash and current evidence for dependent conclusions. No security selection or action decision is supplied or invented; committee debate remains downstream. |"}]}
